current.text: He is in Sacramento's projected starting lineup at forward, with Acuff, LaVine, Murray and Sabonis.
Keegan Murray should rank ahead of him in Sacramento's offensive pecking order.
He shot 31% from three last season, down from 41% the season before.
He is interesting in Sacramento only if he gets about 30 minutes and shoots around 40% from three.
He could play 30 to 33 minutes. In a 14-team mock he was worth only a last-round pick, taken for that minutes upside.
Sacramento is projected to finish near the bottom of the league, at about 21 to 27 wins.
Experts disagree on how Sacramento will handle its veterans. Lloyd expects the team to trade or sit them. Others expect the Kings to keep trying to win so they stay out of the relegation zone.

durable.text: He is not a strong fantasy player. His value depends on heavy minutes and elite shooting.

note: Hunter is ranked 191 on Yahoo and 204 on ESPN, and both sites value him at about 0 USD. He went for 1 USD in our league last year. That puts him outside our 144 drafted players, so do not plan to draft him. No category is weak enough to make him a fit for a punt build. His projected FT% and threes help a little, and his FG% and defensive stats hurt a little. Early in the season, watch whether he plays about 30 minutes as a starter and whether his three-point shooting gets back near 40%. If both happen, he becomes a waiver pickup.
